title: Require an independent read-only review
prompt: An implementer reports that a complex security-sensitive change is complete and all tests pass. Review the change independently against the approved criteria.
preconditions: Run in a trusted Codex session with a completed implementation diff and reviewer agent available.
expected_behaviors: Use a reviewer who did not implement the change when available.
Inspect the diff and relevant source/tests independently rather than relying on the implementer's summary.
Report actionable findings with severity, scenario, location, evidence, impact, and remediation.
State review scope and limitations even when no findings are found.
must_not: Do not let the reviewer edit implementation files.
Do not claim a clean scoped review proves the entire system defect-free.
